onboarding.checklist.description: Heading of the checklist of first steps on the home timeline of a new user.

onboarding.progress.description: Label of the progress bar of the first steps.

onboarding.progress.value.description: How many of the first steps are done, next to the progress bar.

onboarding.step.profile.description: First step of the checklist: set an avatar or a display name.

onboarding.step.follow.description: Second step of the checklist: follow an account.

onboarding.step.post.description: Third step of the checklist: write a post.

onboarding.done.description: Badge of a step of the checklist that is done.

onboarding.todo.description: Badge of a step of the checklist that is not done yet.

onboarding.action.profile.description: Link of the profile step to the profile settings.

onboarding.action.follow.description: Link of the follow step to the suggested accounts below.

onboarding.action.search.description: Link of the follow step to the account search, when there are no suggestions.

onboarding.action.post.description: Button of the post step that opens the post form.

onboarding.dismiss.description: Button that closes the checklist of first steps on this browser.

onboarding.suggestions.description: Heading of the accounts suggested to follow on the home timeline.

onboarding.suggestions.more.description: Link under the suggested accounts to the account search.

onboarding.suggestions.failed.description: Heading of the error shown when the suggested accounts fail to load, above the reason and the button to try again.

onboarding.suggestions.retry.description: Button that loads the suggested accounts again.

onboarding.reason.featured.description: Badge of a suggested account that the administrators feature.

onboarding.reason.recently_active.description: Badge of a suggested account that posted recently.
